verdicts.quote: A bit of puffiness after a big effort is pretty common this far out from ACL surgery and usually settles on its own, so try not to let it worry you.
verdicts.why: Reassures about reported knee swelling and gives an implicit no-action recommendation, instead of only acknowledging it.
No body weight, shape, or appearance mentioned; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Starts with first name, ends with coach name, under 150 words, cites specific match play.
Match day and 7.6 sleep hours match the data; no contradictions found.
